ideas.pitch: A lightweight offline-first mesh networking protocol utilizing Bluetooth LE and Wi-Fi Direct to allow disconnected nodes to relay emergency text messages, vital health logs, and barter inventories without internet infrastructure.
ideas.title: MeshNet Protocol for Post-Collapse Communities
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Day Zero mission of engineering foundational communication infrastructure for civilization's restart.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computing dashboard for managing and routing erratic power output from small-scale solar and kinetic generators among critical survival loads in a micro-community.
ideas.title: BioGen: Decentralized Micro-Grid Energy Allocator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses energy resilience and sustainable engineering, two core evaluation pillars of the Day Zero civilizational reboot.

ideas.pitch: An edge-AI clinical triage assistant running locally on low-power hardware that guides untrained survivors through trauma assessment, wound care, and triage categorization using computer vision and symptom trees.
ideas.title: MedTriage AI: Offline First-Responder Diagnostics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on proven medical simulation win patterns while strictly pivoting to offline post-collapse healthcare scenarios.

ideas.pitch: A localized database and companion recommendation engine matching soil pH and micro-climates with optimal heirloom seed rotation schedules to prevent agricultural failure in a restarted society.
ideas.title: SeedVault: Heirloom Crop & Soil Regeneration Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the fundamental food security and education challenges required to restart civilization from scratch.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision mobile web tool that analyzes colorimetric test strips dipped in water sources to instantly detect heavy metals and biological pathogens without laboratory equipment.
ideas.title: AquaFilter: Low-Tech Contaminant Vision Scanner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical engineering with immediate health infrastructure needs for survivalist communities.
